engine.label: Supertonic 3 · F1 · 8 steps · 4 threads
engine.streaming: one _infer call per segment (8 flow steps, then the vocoder): segment waveforms, not incremental within a segment; full mode is one upstream TextToSpeech.call
engine.chunkPolicy: planSegments: first chunk is the first clause or 4 words of sentence 1, then whole sentences; each waveform cut to its predicted duration, then trimSilence trims it and appends a 150 ms gap
engine.cancellation: between segments; an active _infer runs its eight steps and the vocoder to completion

loadDetail.note: loadMs is four InferenceSession.create calls (intra op threads set, inter op 1) plus unicode indexer and voice style load
